title: Crispy German Pork Ribs
description: A classic German-inspired dish featuring tender pork ribs smothered in a crispy exterior, perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Breadcrumbs
ingredients.notes: Panko or regular breadcrumbs for crispy coating

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter for greasing the pan

ingredients.name: Crispy German Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought blend of herbs and spices

instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Dust the pork ribs with the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured ribs in the beaten egg, making sure they're fully coated.
Roll the egg-coated ribs in the breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs onto the meat to help them stick.
Place the coated ribs in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each rib with butter.
Bake the ribs in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil (high).
Broil the ribs for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the coating is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the ribs from the oven and brush with the crispy German seasoning.
Serve the ribs hot and enjoy!
